title: Drainage
subtitle: Understanding the River Systems of India
subject: Social Science (Geography)
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Define drainage basin and water divide
Differentiate between Himalayan and Peninsular rivers
Understand the major river systems of India (Ganga, Indus, Brahmaputra, Narmada, Tapi, Godavari, Mahanadi, Krishna, Kaveri)
Explain the economic importance of rivers and lakes
Identify causes of river pollution and conservation methods

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the geography of India's river systems, their classification, and economic significance.
common_misconceptions: Thinking all Peninsular rivers flow east.
Assuming all Himalayan rivers originate from the same glacier.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student forgets river directions, ask them to recall the slope of the Deccan plateau.
